Accepted, not a false positive: the mode is deliberate. `mkdtemp` creates the staging directory 0o700, and it is about to be renamed into place as a published model version directory. A sensor running as a different user must be able to traverse and read it, so the mode is widened to 0o755 -- readable and traversable, and writable by nobody but the owner. The write bits are what matter: the artifact reader in `decision/onnx_model.py` refuses any artifact whose mode has `st_mode & 0o022`, so a group- or world-writable model directory could not be loaded even if one were created. This finding was previously unreviewed and the gate had been failing; it was reviewed during the P13 audit.
